purpose: Frozen source contracts for the Actions consolidation plan. This file is not the live event routing catalog.
yaml_note: Ruby Psych resolves bare on to boolean true; events were explicitly recovered from either key. Job metadata preserves the currently invalid release matrix for comparison, not reuse.

apis.description: Optional space-separated API list, e.g. 'path url buffer'

max_per_api.description: Maximum upstream Node tests to sample per API; 0 means no cap

packages.description: Optional comma-separated package specs. Empty uses packages.json.

limit.description: Maximum packages to sweep. Use 0 for all selected packages.

strict.description: Fail the workflow if any package fails.

cut_release.description: Release the dispatched candidate: gates/builds, npm OIDC publish, registry verification, then tag + GitHub Release.

nightly.description: Build this exact commit and publish its host/cross archives as a GitHub prerelease. Does not run stable release gates or publish to npm.

candidate_sha.description: Required with cut_release: exact pushed candidate SHA. Prevents a moved branch from publishing or being tagged.

dist_tag.description: npm dist-tag for a cut release (normally latest).

socket_scan.description: Run the optional Socket tarball scan before npm publication.

existing_tag.description: Re-publish an existing release (e.g. v0.5.1300): rebuild and re-upload assets / re-run publish legs for that tag. Replaces the old implicit 'latest release' fallback.

publish_npm.description: With existing_tag: also (re-)publish the npm packages. release / cut_release runs always publish npm.

concurrency.group: release-packages-${{ github.event.release.tag_name || inputs.existing_tag || ((inputs.cut_release || inputs.nightly) && inputs.candidate_sha) || github.run_id }}

publish-assets.if:
!cancelled() && needs.preflight.outputs.tag != '' && needs.build.result == 'success' && contains(fromJSON('["success", "failure"]'), needs.build-cross.result) && (
  (needs.preflight.outputs.mode == 'cut-release' && needs.create-release.result == 'success') ||
  (needs.preflight.outputs.mode == 'nightly' && needs.create-nightly.result == 'success') ||
  (needs.preflight.outputs.mode != 'cut-release' && needs.preflight.outputs.mode != 'nightly')
)

npm-publish.if:
!cancelled() && needs.build.result == 'success' && (
  (needs.preflight.outputs.mode == 'cut-release' && needs.build-cross.result == 'success') ||
  (needs.preflight.outputs.mode == 'release' && contains(fromJSON('["success", "failure"]'), needs.build-cross.result)) ||
  (needs.preflight.outputs.mode == 'republish' && inputs.publish_npm && contains(fromJSON('["success", "failure"]'), needs.build-cross.result))
)

update_gap_snapshot.description: Re-baseline test-parity/gap_snapshot.json: run the whole gap suite as ONE shard with UPDATE_SNAPSHOT=1 and upload the resulting snapshot as an artifact (`gap-snapshot-update`) for you to commit. Nothing else about the run changes.
